entries.name: Composite Construction
entries.effect: Durability 20 or +10 Durability; a second Q can make the weapon nonmetallic to detectors.

entries.name: Extended Barrel
entries.effect: Firearms +1 vs Adjacent Zone, but Firearms -1 into Shared Zone.

entries.name: Extended Magazine
entries.effect: Increase firearm Capacity by roughly 3–5+ rounds; large extensions may remove Defensive/Concealment.

entries.name: Genemapped Security
entries.effect: Powered functions only work for a specified individual; Hardwired.

entries.name: Mag-Plating
entries.effect: Linked one-handed/pistol weapon can be magnetically recalled to the user; requires compatible synthetic/bionic interface.

entries.name: Magazine
entries.effect: Attachment providing rapid reload up to weapon Capacity; spare magazines occupy space.

entries.name: Scope
entries.effect: While Deployed, Aim can grant Firearms +1 against Shared-Zone targets.

entries.name: Scope, Longshot
entries.effect: Deployed long-range Aim grants Firearms +1 and ignores one Distant Zone for Difficulty.

entries.name: Scope, Sniper
entries.effect: Advanced long-range Aim/Rangefinder; Linked ocular/helmet systems improve bonuses and range.

entries.name: Sight, Laser
entries.effect: Firearms — Pistol/Small Arms +1 in Shared Zone; Powered; often an Attachment.

entries.name: Stock, Folding
entries.effect: Small Arm can be deployed for Firearms +1; increases size and requires both hands while deployed.
